ends.note: ends at the unnamed N-S alley west of the Casino (x ~2156); does not reach Linn

notes: Baymiller jogs at Clark: north of Clark it runs at x ~410 (in line with sheet 60's Baymiller), south of Clark at x ~846-827, so two Baymiller/Clark T's. Jordan Street (from sheet 60) runs south from Clark at x ~374 to Gest; printed 19 ft at the north end and 10 ft at the south end. Gest jogs at Baymiller: west of Baymiller centre y ~3116 (50 ft), east of Baymiller y ~3002-3020 (printed 36' near Baymiller and 40' near Linn); Gest ends at Linn. Intermediate Avenue is printed 'INTERMEDIATE (NOBLE CT.) AV.' and runs Clark to Gest only (F. B. Dyer Public School south of Gest). Clark printed 50' near Rittenhouse (a rotated '40'' near Baymiller-north is probably the same street; measured ~50 ft both ends). Unnamed alleys: (1) N-S alley at x ~2156 between the 808-811 lots and the Casino, Hopkins to Clark, printed '14'' near Hopkins and '10'' near Clark (measured ~12 ft); Pierce Alley ends at it. (2) 10 ft N-S alley at x ~3025 from Hopkins to Clark, crossing Rankin Alley at about (3025, 1037). (3) 20 ft passage from West Court north to the rear of the school lot at x ~1700 (dead end at y ~3783). Rankin Alley printed 'RANKIN ALLEY' (10 ft), from Linn east off the sheet. Hand, Linn, Jordan, Rittenhouse, Clark, Gest, Hopkins, Baymiller printed without suffix; 'Street' assumed. Sheet is rotated slightly (E-W streets drop ~15 px across the sheet).
